llm_fields.description: The Karnataka Bhagya Lakshmi Scheme provides financial assistance to girl children from below‑poverty‑line families to promote their birth and improve their status in the family and society.
llm_fields.eligibility: Girl’s birth must be registered within one year of birth; the girl must not be engaged in child labour; benefits are available to BPL families with up to two female children; the girl must be immunized under the health department program; she must be born after 31 March 2006 in a BPL family; she must have completed the eighth grade to receive the maturity amount; she cannot be married before turning 18 years old.
